text:
elaine_fin: Heads-up: Polaris Metrics (acct PM-1199) flagged for disputed usage and non-payment. Outstanding: INV-20240801 ($32,100) + INV-20240701 ($18,750) = $50,850. Client insists a metering error double-billed a peak batch and wants invoice correction + portal unlock to pay remainder. They threatened to escalate to procurement/legal if we continue collections. @maya_support @tom_sales can we coordinate?

billing-bot: System note: invoices: INV-20240801 ($32,100) - disputed line item $9,600; INV-20240701 ($18,750). Last payment recorded: $7,500 on 2024-06-20. Status: PAST_DUE. Collections vendor: Northshore Active outreach started 2024-09-14.

chris_collections: They've only answered emails. Collections recommends a 7-day hold while finance investigates, otherwise resume standard dunning. Need a clear owner for the reconciliation.

maya_support: I can allow a 40-minute portal unlock for ACH once bank verification is complete. Workflow: open ticket, run KYC and fraud checks, then run `/unlock-portal --acct=PM-1199 --minutes=40 --by=maya_support`. Clients must upload docs to https://vault.redwood/payments-upload (no channel attachments).

tom_sales: I'll own comms. Proposal: ask client to pay undisputed balance now (INV-20240701 + INV-20240801 minus disputed $9,600 = $41,250) during unlock window, while we investigate the $9,600 meter claim. Offer to escrow disputed amount to be returned or applied after reconciliation.

elaine_fin: Finance ops can mark disputed amount and place $9,600 in provisional escrow (AR hold) during reconciliation. Policy: provisional credits > $2,000 need CFO sign-off if taken as write-off. Escrowing for dispute resolution is allowed by ops. We should log GL tag MR-AR-ESCROW.

victor_cfo: Approve holding $9,600 in provisional escrow pending technical reconciliation for up to 21 days. Approve 40-minute portal unlock after KYC & voided check or micro-deposit verification. Condition: client signs a dispute acknowledgement and agrees to release remaining undisputed funds. Collections: pause for 7 days (resume 2024-09-22). Add account note: "ESCROW_9600_VICTOR_2024-09-15". No unilateral write-off without CFO approval.

maya_support: Creating ticket SB-98760 and will run KYC/fraud checks. Will attach verification logs and only run `/unlock-portal` after docs are validated.

tom_sales: Messaging client now with the proposal: pay undisputed portion during unlock, upload KYC documents, and sign the dispute acknowledgement. CC collections & finance.

chris_collections: Pausing external outreach until 2024-09-22 COB. If no payment or signed ack by then, we'll resume escalation.

elaine_fin: I'll apply the AR tag MR-AR-ESCROW and prepare reconciliation workflow with billing team. Will notify when escrow journal entry is posted. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
